Get EASL Play-by-Play

Source: R/easl.R
easl_pbp.Rd

Play-by-play of a finished game in delivered order, with the running score and the points each event scored.

Endpoint: GET https://easl.joshricha.com/api/v1/matches/{fixture_id}/playbyplay

Usage

easl_pbp(fixture_id)

Arguments

fixture_id

(required) DataCore fixture (game) UUID v1, e.g. '10af8fd4-106e-11f1-960b-5798087c7aa3' (the 2025-26 EASL Championship): the 'id' of easl_schedule rows. Only finished (CONFIRMED) games are served; a malformed id is hoopR_bad_request.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with one row per play-by-play event. Its columns are listed in return_columns (subset(return_columns, fn == "easl_pbp")) and in the searchable return columns article.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in easl_health().

Event descriptions

  • Shot types: Jump shot, Layup, Driving layup, Pull-up jump shot, Floating jump shot, Tip-in, Fadeaway, Step-back jump shot, Turnaround jump shot, Hook shot, Dunk, Reverse layup, Alley-oop, Alley-oop dunk, Euro step (none on 23 rows: '3pt missed').

  • Shot modifiers: in the paint, second chance, from turnover, fast break, blocked.

  • Other events (complete list; N FT = free throws awarded): Assist; Block; Steal; Substitution in; Substitution out; Defensive rebound; Defensive rebound (team); Offensive rebound; Offensive rebound (team); Foul; Foul (N FT); Foul drawn; Foul drawn (N FT); Personal foul; Personal foul (N FT); Personal foul (shooting); Personal foul (shooting) (N FT); Offensive foul; Offensive foul (charge); Technical foul; Technical foul (N FT); Bench technical foul; Bench technical foul (N FT); Coach technical foul; Coach technical foul (N FT); Unsportsmanlike foul; Unsportsmanlike foul (N FT); Disqualifying foul (N FT); Jump ball won; Jump ball won (held ball); Jump ball lost; Full timeout; Short timeout; Media timeout; Commercial timeout; Officials timeout; Officials timeout (mandatory); Coach's challenge (pending); Coach's challenge (complete) - upheld; Coach's challenge (complete) - overturned; Instant replay review (complete) - upheld; Instant replay review (complete) - overturned; Turnover - Bad pass; Ball handling; Traveling; Out of bounds; Offensive; Backcourt violation; Double dribble; Carrying; Offensive goaltending; 3 second violation; 5 second violation; 5 second violation (team); 8 second violation (team); Shot clock violation (team); Other; Other (team).

See also

family_easl lists every function in this family.
